profile.name: NI计数器输出模块
profile.description: 这是一类带有计数器/定时器输出通道的NI数据采集设备，可按设定的初始延时、高电平时间、低电平时间或周期输出定时脉冲信号。实验中常用于产生TTL触发、同步脉冲、门控信号或时序控制信号，以协调激光、相机、探测器和其他仪器的工作。
profile.description_en: This is an NI data acquisition device with counter/timer output channels that can generate timed pulse signals with defined initial delay, high time, low time, or period. In laboratories, it is commonly used to produce TTL triggers, synchronization pulses, gating signals, or timing control signals for coordinating lasers, cameras, detectors, and other instruments.
